title: Folding egress-gated fetch into a verb: re-validate every redirect hop
summary: When a CLI verb gains URL input and fetches through secureFetch/runExternalOperation, entry-URL validation alone is an SSRF bypass — follow-redirects chases a 3xx to a denied or private host. Re-run assertNetworkEgress on each hop via axios beforeRedirect (options.href holds the resolved target).
hint_triggers: When a perception or utility verb folds in remote fetching: (1) wrap the call in runExternalOperation with the read-only op id (network:fetch_read; requiresApproval:false, delegable:false, observationOnly:true) and attest argv-derived params as authority:user via withOperationArgumentOrigins; (2) entry-URL validation is NOT enough — axios follows 3xx unchecked, so a redirect to a private or policy-denied host bypasses egress. Add beforeRedirect that calls assertNetworkEgress on options.href for every hop; (3) classify governance denials ([A-Z_]{4,} bracketed tags, sandbox/policy/approval stops) as permission_denied non-retryable, never as retryable network failures; (4) keep unit tests hermetic through an injectable fetch seam, but add one module-mock test that exercises the real governed wiring (secureFetch call shape + redirect re-validation); (5) an Office zip without a filename extension cannot name its format — refuse with the save-and-read recovery path instead of guessing.
